In the foreground, a player in a red jersey with a shield logo skates towards the right, stickhandling a black hockey puck. To the left, a goalie in black gear is in a crouched position, and another player in a dark blue/black jersey is visible in the background. The scene takes place on an ice rink with yellow boards.
